+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import textwrap
+
+from ._textwrap import TextWrapper
+
+_PREFIX = "  "
+
+
+def _split_paragraphs(text: str) -> list[list[str]]:
+    paragraphs: list[list[str]] = []
+    buf: list[str] = []
+
+    for line in text.splitlines():
+        if line.strip():
+            buf.append(line.rstrip())
+        elif buf:
+            paragraphs.append(buf)
+            buf = []
+
+    if buf:
+        paragraphs.append(buf)
+
+    return paragraphs
+
+
+def notice_panel(text: str, width: int = 78) -> str:
+    """Format text as an indented notice panel.
+
+    Every line of the result starts with two spaces, and prose is
+    wrapped so that lines are at most ``width`` characters long.
+    Paragraphs are separated by blank lines, which are kept as a single
+    separator line. The indentation of each paragraph relative to the
+    least indented one is preserved.
+
+    A paragraph whose first line contains only the ``\\b`` character
+    (``\\x08``) is preformatted: the marker line is dropped and the
+    remaining lines are emitted literally, without rewrapping.
+
+    :param text: the text to format.
+    :param width: the maximum line width, including the two space
+        prefix. Must be at least 4.
+    :raises ValueError: if ``width`` is less than 4.
+
+    .. versionadded:: 8.2.2
+    """
+    if width < 4:
+        raise ValueError(f"width must be at least 4, got {width}.")
+
+    paragraphs = _split_paragraphs(textwrap.dedent(text.expandtabs()))
+
+    if not paragraphs:
+        return ""
+
+    # Keep at least one column for content, however deep the indent.
+    max_indent = width - len(_PREFIX) - 1
+    blocks: list[str] = []
+
+    for lines in paragraphs:
+        if lines[0].strip() == "\b":
+            body = lines[1:]
+
+            if body:
+                blocks.append("\n".join(f"{_PREFIX}{line}" for line in body))
+
+            continue
+
+        first = lines[0]
+        indent = min(len(first) - len(first.lstrip()), max_indent)
+        prefix = _PREFIX + " " * indent
+        wrapper = TextWrapper(
+            width,
+            initial_indent=prefix,
+            subsequent_indent=prefix,
+            break_on_hyphens=False,
+        )
+        blocks.append(wrapper.fill(" ".join(line.strip() for line in lines)))
+
+    return f"\n{_PREFIX}\n".join(blocks)

@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.notice_panel import notice_panel
+
+
+def test_empty():
+    assert notice_panel("") == ""
+    assert notice_panel("  \n\n ") == ""
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [3, 0, -1])
+def test_width_too_small(width):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        notice_panel("text", width=width)
+
+
+def test_wraps_with_prefix():
+    text = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit, sed do."
+    rv = notice_panel(text * 3, width=30)
+    lines = rv.splitlines()
+    assert len(lines) > 1
+    assert all(line.startswith("  ") for line in lines)
+    assert all(len(line) <= 30 for line in lines)
+    assert " ".join(line.strip() for line in lines) == " ".join((text * 3).split())
+
+
+def test_paragraphs_and_relative_indent():
+    text = "  First paragraph.\n\n\n      Second one\n      continues.\n\n  Third."
+    assert notice_panel(text) == (
+        "  First paragraph.\n  \n      Second one continues.\n  \n  Third."
+    )
+
+
+def test_preformatted():
+    text = "Intro text.\n\n\b\ncode   one\n    nested   two\n\nOutro."
+    assert notice_panel(text, width=10) == (
+        "  Intro\n  text.\n  \n  code   one\n      nested   two\n  \n  Outro."
+    )
+
+
+def test_default_width():
+    rv = notice_panel("word " * 100)
+    assert all(len(line) <= 78 for line in rv.splitlines())
notes:
Added src/click/notice_panel.py, which dedents the text, splits it into paragraphs on blank lines, wraps each with click's TextWrapper under a two-space prefix plus the paragraph's relative indent (capped so at least one column stays free), and emits \b paragraphs verbatim. Paragraphs are joined by a single separator line that is just two spaces, so every line starts with two spaces. Also added tests, a changelog entry and an API docs entry.
